description: R-ERR-1 channels per route (read/write copy): the same duplicate-key INSERT INTO T (Code) VALUES ('a1') through Connection.Execute, Command.Execute, Recordset.Open of the SQL text, and a server keyset AddNew with Code "a1" and Update, a client batch AddNew with Code "a1" and UpdateBatch, and an edit of row 2's Code to "a1" with Update; then DELETE of the referenced P row 1 through Connection.Execute, the saved action query QSet executed by Command with no parameter values, and Execute of the missing name "QNoSuch". The Errors collection is cleared before each route and read after it (Number, Description, Source, SQLState, NativeError); the call's own HRESULT and EXCEPINFO are captured by the call. Asks the Errors entries and the Automation error each route produces for the same cause.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
